verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a dedicated SOC 2 product with automated tests and evidence collection, a library of pre-built frameworks and controls, AI-drafted policies, and auditor collaboration including Information Request Lists. The evidence does not explicitly show Type I versus Type II workflows, named Trust Services Criteria, or SOC 2-specific policy templates, so coverage of the full story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II audit support, explicit Trust Services Criteria control mapping, a documented required-policy template set for SOC 2, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform
